title: Disabling and re-enabling of UE's N1 mode capability

entities.name: UE N1 mode capability
entities.description: The UE's capability to operate in N1 mode, which can be disabled and re-enabled.

entities.name: Disable N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure to disable the UE's N1 mode capability.

entities.name: Re-enable N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure to re-enable the UE's N1 mode capability.

relations.description: Disabling procedure establishes the disabled state of UE N1 mode capability.
Re-enabling procedure establishes the enabled state of UE N1 mode capability.
